t.t: Abdin Pharmacies return policy for online purchases, return conditions, exceptions, and refund timing.

div.p: Clear return conditions for purchases from Abdin Pharmacies.
Returns must be within fourteen days of purchase.
Items must be new, unused, tagged, and in original packaging.
Card refunds may take up to 21 business days.

article.p: All returns must be within fourteen (14) days of the purchase date.
All returned items must be in a new and unused condition. With all original tags and labels attached and its original packaging.
For returned item proof of purchase is required.
The following items cannot be returned or exchanged:

ul.li: After offer or discount date time for purchases with offer or discount.
Products that are kept in the refrigerator, cosmetic products or easy to open are not returned or exchanged

article.p: As soon as the sales branch receives the product and in the event that the terms of return and acceptance apply to the product, the amount will be refunded to the customer's credit card
Our customer will receive a refund within a certain number of days depending on his/her credit card issuer's policies, up to 21 business days.
